---
indicator_code: "APX-001"
indicator_name: "Approved but Unpaid Claims in ERP"
definition: |
  The **total count and value** of claims that have been approved in ERP but have **not yet been paid**. This    indicator measures the outstanding payment backlog at any point in time, giving operations visibility into
  claims that are ready for disbursement but remain unsettled.
numerator: |
  - Count of claims in ERP where status = **Unpaid**
  - Value of claims in ERP where status = **Unpaid**
denominator: |
  - Total count of claims in ERP
  - Total value of claims in ERP
unit_of_measure: |
  - **Count** — number of unpaid claims in ERP
  - **KES** — total value of unpaid claims in ERP
data_source: |
  - SHA ERP
  - Fund types covered: **SHIF**, **ECCIF**, **POMSF**, **PHC**
frequency: "Real-time; values refresh on each page load."
disaggregation: |
  - County
  - Healthcare Provider (within county)
  - Fund Type (SHIF / ECCIF / POMSF/PHC)
  - Date Created
notes_caveats: |
  - The ERP is the **authoritative source of truth** for payment status. 
  - The indicator reflects a snapshot at the time of page load; live processing may cause
    minor fluctuations between views.
  - Values are in **nominal KES** — no inflation adjustment is applied.
sdg_who_ref: |
  **SDG 3.8** — Achieve universal health coverage, including financial risk protection and
  access to quality essential health-care services.
---
